    Cane toad records in Australia (real data from GBIF)

    Source: R/data.R
    cane_toad.Rd

    Occurrence records of the cane toad (Rhinella marina) in Australia from 1935, the year of its release at Gordonvale, Queensland (about 145.79 E, 17.10 S), to 2024. These are real records downloaded from the GBIF occurrence API on 27 November 2026 with these filters: country Australia, coordinates present, no geospatial issues, occurrence status present, licence CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0. Records were then restricted to coordinate uncertainty of 10 km or less (or not stated) and to specimen, observation and occurrence records, and thinned to one record per 0.1 degree grid cell per year.

    Usage

    cane_toad

    Format

    A tibble with 6,680 rows and 11 columns:

    gbif_id

    GBIF occurrence key. The record is at https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/<gbif_id>.

    species

    Scientific name, "Rhinella marina".

    year, month

    Year and month of the record (month may be NA).

    lon, lat

    Decimal longitude and latitude (WGS84).

    state

    State or territory as given by the publisher.

    basis_of_record

    GBIF basis of record.

    coordinate_uncertainty_m

    Coordinate uncertainty in metres.

    dataset_key

    GBIF key of the publishing dataset; see cane_toad_sources.

    licence

    "CC BY 4.0" or "CC0 1.0".

    Source

    GBIF.org, GBIF Occurrence Search, https://www.gbif.org, accessed through https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search on 27 November 2026. Records are published by the 30 datasets listed in cane_toad_sources under CC BY 4.0 or CC0 1.0. Credit those datasets when you use the data. The download and cleaning code is in data-raw/make_data.R in the package source.

    References

    Phillips, B. L., Brown, G. P., Webb, J. K. and Shine, R. (2006). Invasion and the evolution of speed in toads. Nature, 439, 803. doi:10.1038/439803a

    Examples

    cane_toad
#> # A tibble: 6,680 × 11
#>    gbif_id    species          year month   lon   lat state      basis_of_record
#>    <chr>      <chr>           <int> <int> <dbl> <dbl> <chr>      <chr>          
#>  1 3779737797 Rhinella marina  1935     6  146. -17.1 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  2 3778768717 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -17.9 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  3 3778772911 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -17.1 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  4 3779026696 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -18.6 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  5 3779308017 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -16.9 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  6 3779431297 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -18.6 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  7 3779762508 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -17.2 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  8 3779791887 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -17.5 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#>  9 3780084613 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -18.2 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#> 10 3780306368 Rhinella marina  1936    NA  146. -16.9 Queensland OCCURRENCE     
#> # ℹ 6,670 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: coordinate_uncertainty_m <dbl>, dataset_key <chr>,
#> #   licence <chr>
table(cane_toad$licence)
#>
